resources.string: Two original Lenovo A65 grass wallpapers, rebuilt with native Canvas for Android 15 while keeping their motion and artwork.
Lenovo A65 firmware assets · Android 15 port
200 wind-blown blades under a sky that moves from stars to sunrise, daylight and sunset with your local time.
100 blades, fireflies and dandelions across a four-stage day. Tap the grass to release extra particles.
The classic AOSP grass wallpaper. A clear blue sky and dense blades transition through night, dawn and sunset. All 200 original blades are kept.
The MediaTek version. Dandelion seeds drift with changing winds by day; fireflies blink and wander at night. Tap the grass for extra particles.
The original AOSP grass wallpaper from Lenovo A65. 200 blades drift from a starry night through dawn to sunset. This installation contains only this wallpaper.
The original MediaTek grass wallpaper from Lenovo A65. 100 blades, fireflies and dandelions; tap the grass for extra particles. This installation contains only this wallpaper.

The applied wallpaper follows local time; the system preview runs a 30-second day/night loop. Camera, location and Internet permissions are not requested. Day phases use fixed approximate boundaries. Tap effects depend on launcher support for live-wallpaper touch.
Assets from Lenovo A65 firmware · AOSP grass is Apache 2.0
The system live-wallpaper preview is unavailable. Choose the wallpaper from the system wallpaper picker instead.
System preview opened. Tap “Set wallpaper” to apply it.
